items.title: 9.8 Solubility product (for slightly soluble ionic compounds) (kam ghulne wale ionic compounds ke liye) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8 (Solubility Product) with Table 9.5, printed pages 201-202.

blocks.text: Jab NaCl jaisa ghulne wala ionic compound pani mein dissolve hota hai to woh poori tarah ions mein toot jata hai. Lekin kam ghulne wale (slightly soluble) salts equilibrium par poori tarah dissociate nahi hote. Example ke taur par PbSO₄ ko pani ke saath hilayen to solution mein Pb²⁺, SO₄²⁻ aur bina toota PbSO₄ hota hai. Yani solid PbSO₄ aur dissolved (ghule hue) ions Pb²⁺ aur SO₄²⁻ ke darmiyan equilibrium hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein dissolved (ghule hue) ions “SO₄²⁻ and SO₄²⁻” likhe hain; sahi Pb²⁺ aur SO₄²⁻ hain.
Lead sulphate ek well-known (mashhoor) kam ghulne wala (sparingly soluble) compound hai aur PbCl₂ ki tarah bohat thora dissociate hota hai:
Kam ghulne wala salt hone ki wajah se PbSO₄ ki concentration taqreeban constant rehti hai. [PbSO₄] ko Kc ke saath baen taraf (L.H.S.) le aayen:

blocks.text_alt: Kc[PbSO₄] = [Pb²⁺][SO₄²⁻]; if Kc[PbSO₄] = Ksp, then Ksp = [Pb²⁺][SO₄²⁻] = 1.6 × 10⁻⁸ at 25°C

blocks.text: Ksp ko PbSO₄ ka solubility product kehte hain.

blocks.title: Solubility product
blocks.text: Equilibrium par dono ions ki molar solubilities (mol dm⁻³ mein concentrations) ka product (zarb) solubility product hai.
Isi tarah ek aur kam ghulne wale salt PbCl₂ ke liye:
Room temperature par Ksp aam taur par bohat chhoti value hoti hai, aur yeh temperature par depend karti hai.

blocks.title: Solubility product (Ksp)
blocks.text: Solubility product ions ki concentrations ka product hai, jab har concentration par balanced equation ka coefficient power (exponent) ke taur par laga ho.
Ksp ki value batati hai ke kam ghulne wala salt kitna dissociate hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Table 9.5 mein teen ion products ghalat chhape hain: CuS ke liye “[S²⁺]” (sahi [S²⁻]), BaSO₄ ke liye “[Ba] [CO₄²⁻]” (sahi [Ba²⁺][SO₄²⁻]), aur CaCO₃ ke liye “[Ca₃²⁻]” (sahi [Ca²⁺][CO₃²⁻]).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Ksp likhne ka method: salt ke ions ki concentrations ko multiply karein, aur har ion ki concentration par us ka coefficient power bana dein. Solid salt expression mein nahi aata. Example: CaF₂ ⇌ Ca²⁺ + 2F⁻, to Ksp = [Ca²⁺][F⁻]².

blocks.prompt: Ag₂CrO₄, Al(OH)₃ aur Fe₂S₃ ke Ksp expressions likhein, aur batayein ke solid salt in mein kyun nahi aata.
blocks.explanation: Ag₂CrO₄: Ksp = [Ag⁺]²[CrO₄²⁻]; Al(OH)₃: Ksp = [Al³⁺][OH⁻]³; Fe₂S₃: Ksp = [Fe³⁺]²[S²⁻]³. Bina ghula solid bohat zyada hai aur us ki concentration constant hai, is liye use Kc ke saath mila kar Ksp bana diya jata hai, bilkul jaise pani Kw mein shamil hua.

items: Kam ghulne wala salt pani mein apne ions ke saath equilibrium mein hota hai.
Ksp = Kc[solid] = ions ki concentrations ka product, har ek par us ka coefficient power: PbSO₄ ke liye 1.6 × 10⁻⁸; PbCl₂ ke liye Ksp = [Pb²⁺][Cl⁻]².
Ksp bohat chhota, temperature par depend karta hai, aur dissociation ka measure hai (Table 9.5).
